title: Beatrix and the Echo
author: Xanthe Pemberton
blurb: Mara Vasquez, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
